body: Two pieces per the item's own scoping: (a) RSS poller over the Fed's public monetary-policy feed, same discover->load-seen->dedupe->append shape as prwatch.RunDiscovery, real encoding/xml parsing (not regex -- this source is well-formed RSS unlike PR Newswire); (b) the Fed's own published FOMC meeting calendar 2021-2027, fetched live from federalreserve.gov and cross-checked against the live press feed's own statement dates (both match exactly) -- sourced from the Fed's schedule, not invented. New cmd/fed-watch, one-shot systemd-timer idiom like bond-watcher. 20 tests using a real RSS fixture captured live, not synthesized. go build/vet/test ./... clean. Verified end-to-end against the real live feed: 15 real press releases discovered/persisted/deduped correctly across two runs, next-meeting computation correct (Sep 15-16 2026). Commit 06705e2.
title: S165-03: fedwatch -- Federal Reserve / FOMC data, Phase 3
